user_direction: Fix sustained trainer battle failure and continue toward project completion; training assistance is authorized.
capability: Learn useful attacks, reserve selections and switch timing from completed trainer fights and intermediate battle boundaries.
learned_authority: Fitted move and reserve heads select concrete actions; control targets use their measured returns, and the integrated candidate owns every evaluation action.
transfer_test: Eight reserved TRAIN variations change opponent level, HP and move order. These are within-origin diagnostics. Separate natural origins remain required for promotion.
cheapest_falsifier: Any declared terminal branch truncates, fewer than 24 complete contexts including intermediate states are available, or the resulting candidate still loses/loops in the reserved battles.
time_box: Two hours for this experiment and diagnosis; no full-game execution.
stop_condition: Preserve all outcomes; stop collection on a nonterminal branch or invalid execution. One 1200-epoch fit follows valid collection, with no same-corpus optimizer sweep. Failure does not authorize promotion.
training_origins: Four existing qualified TRAIN origins retain their identities. Teacher-assisted new setups do not become independent natural origins.
intermediate_captures: First two decision boundaries after the opening in each teacher trajectory; select before outcome, retain MAIN/prompt/forced contexts with at least two legal choices.
continuation: Disclosed fixed stat-damage teacher, declining optional switches and choosing forced reserves from visible mechanics. Labels are measured terminal branch returns.
reward: Unchanged whole-party return v2; retain old 52 contexts as anchors and report original 44/all 52 retention separately.
reserved_comparison: Eight paired candidate/frozen TRAIN rollouts at timing 0. No natural promotion claim regardless of result.
